resolution.multiple_matches: load the union of all matched routes
resolution.ambiguous: ask the user, listing candidate route ids
resolution.hard_rule: if real funds or live venue API keys are reachable from the code being written, DOMAINS/live_trading_gate.md, DOMAINS/financial_audit_ledger.md, and DOMAINS/trading_compliance.md are mandatory regardless of matched route
resolution.deploy_rule: if the task merges to a deployed branch or ships to production infrastructure, DOMAINS/deployment_and_audit.md is mandatory in addition to the matched routes

routes.description: Strategy research, backtesting, signal/alpha work; no live keys reachable
routes.notes: QT-DET parity rules apply even offline; the ledger books simulated fills so paper and live accounting share one code path. exhaustive_research.md governs how the backtest itself is run — hypothesis-space breadth, cost/regime sensitivity, negative-result reporting — not just the code that runs it. market_data_quality.md governs the data those backtests are built on; portfolio_risk.md and model_lifecycle.md apply once results feed into allocation or promotion decisions.

routes.description: Order execution, market-making, trailing stops — anything touching venue APIs with real keys
routes.hard_gate: DOMAINS/live_trading_gate.md — every LIVE-n item must PASS before any live deploy; no overrides
routes.notes: exhaustive_research.md's RESEARCH-17 is the gate LIVE-17's shadow-stage ramp assumes was already satisfied before shadow trading begins. trading_compliance.md is also force-loaded via the hard_rule the instant real funds are reachable, so it's listed here for clarity even though it's redundant with that rule.

routes.description: LLM agentic loops, multi-agent orchestration, tool-using assistants
routes.notes: Ledger is loaded for AGT-2/LGR-16 spend metering — budget caps must be auditable, not advisory.

routes.description: Reinforcement learning training or serving pipelines
routes.notes: AGT section 5 is the core payload; model_lifecycle.md's versioning/decay/rollback rules apply to a trained policy exactly as they do to any other trading model. If the environment is a market or the policy places orders, quant_live_execution also matches — load the union.

routes.description: RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector stores, retrieval
Backend services, APIs, databases, platform-grade systems (enterprise ledgers, manufacturing, asset inventories)
routes.notes: If the platform books money or inventory quantities, financial_audit_ledger.md is strongly indicated; FS-14..16 assume it for balance math.

routes.description: Frontends, dashboards, terminal interfaces, design systems
routes.notes: fullstack_architecture.md rides along for FS-17..FS-20 — a frontend that consumes APIs is a contract consumer and belongs on the blast-radius map.

routes.description: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, production deployment and release engineering
routes.notes: Also loaded implicitly by the deploy_rule whenever any other route's task ships to production.
